content.short: BitOK is a portfolio monitoring and AML platform on TON, providing tools for risk management and tax reporting.
content.description: BitOK is a comprehensive portfolio management and AML (Anti-Money Laundering) compliance platform that supports the TON blockchain. it provides users and businesses with powerful tools to track their digital asset holdings, monitor transaction history, and generate accurate tax reports. Additionally, BitOK features robust AML screening capabilities, allowing users to assess the risk levels of addresses and transactions to prevent engagement with illicit activities. It is a critical tool for maintaining financial transparency and security in the Web3 space.
content.meta: Manage your TON portfolio and stay compliant with BitOK. Risk management and tax tools on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
